failure_condition: A button in an open shadow root has no accessible name.
preconditions: Load either TC06 variant and wait for component initialization.
interaction_steps: Inspect the component's button in the DOM and Accessibility Tree.
expected_outcome: The control variant has a named button inside the open shadow root.
manual_verification_method: Inspect the button in browser accessibility tools and test it with keyboard input.
dom_testability: Testable only if the capture explicitly traverses the open shadow root.
accessibility_tree_testability: Testable when Chromium includes the shadow descendant and computed name.
limitations: Closed shadow roots and browser-specific tree behavior are outside this fixture.
